title: How do you guys actually USE AI in gamedev?
author: More-Drink2211
selftext:
For context, I just made a bunch of three.js games using Gemini, just for a start. Now looking at videos where they are merging Minecraft and GTA into one, it doesn't seem like you can just ask ChatGPT, "Hey, please make me a video game about building but its GTA"

So as the question implies, do you guys:  
\- Use AI to generate concept art and ideas and then make the models and game yourself?  
\- Use AI to make the game itself, like physically making the models, assets and code in actual game engines like UE5 and Unity? If so, how, considering I can't get Gemini to make a single line of HTML without messing up something?  
\- Something in between?

I would like to learn more about this, I'm not exactly an AI genius, so forgive me if this post sounds poorly worded or has incorrect terminology.

comments.author: zayelion
comments.body: I use given when then,  to right short requirements.
